messages:
adele: Quick heads-up — I'm seeing a small but consistent overlap between our holdout and synthetic fixtures after the quantized-runner bring-up. ~0.6% of holdout IDs show up in the generated fixtures.
jay: can you paste a couple sample ids and how you found them?
adele: sure — ran a simple grep against the generated fixtures. snippet:
```
$ grep -Ff holdout_ids.txt synthetic/fixtures/2026-03-20/*.ndjson | head
a3f5c2d4e9bf7c1a2e9d4c3b7f6a1c2d
b7e9d1a4c3f2e6b8d4a1f3c2e9b5d6a
c8d2b1a9e3f4c6d7b2a9c8e5f1d3b4a
```
sasha: :thinking: Did we change the seed_map or fixture-naming in the synthetic generator in the last deploy? I recall a rename on 2026-02-14 that changed shard naming conventions.
mike: @adele can you also run the holdout verifier tool with the current shard manifest and paste the output? `./tools/verify-holdout --shard-manifest s3://eval-artifacts/manifest.json`
adele: ran it, output below (truncated):
```
$ ./tools/verify-holdout --shard-manifest s3://eval-artifacts/manifest.json
FOUND_OVERLAPS: 3
overlap_ids: [a3f5c2d4e9..., b7e9d1a4c3..., c8d2b1a9e3...]
overlap_shards: [shard-05, shard-12, shard-05]
manifest_source: s3://eval-artifacts/manifest.json (etag: "7a9d3cc")
cached_manifest_key: redis://cache.eval/shardlist:v1 (age: 37h)
```
ci-bot: verify-holdout job finished — status: fail — 3 overlaps detected. job: <https://ci.redwood/internal/verify-holdout/782>
sasha: that cache age is the smoking gun — we moved to the new naming scheme (commit 7a9d3cc) but the fetch path for the runner still reads the old key. stale shardlist got used to generate fixtures.
jay: simple short-term fix: runner should validate loaded fixture ids against the canonical holdout index at startup and fail if any overlap found. long-term: fix the cache key resolution and add an automated TTL purge when manifests rotate.
mike: I'll open a quick PR to add the startup assertion + CI test that generates a tiny synthetic batch and asserts disjointness with the golden holdout. linking the PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1420|PR#1420>
adele: thanks — also added one-off remediation: flushed the Redis key `eval:shardlist:v1` and reuploaded the canonical manifest. reran verifier and got zero overlaps.
ci-bot: re-run verify-holdout job #783 — status: success — 0 overlaps.
jay: can we add a lightweight GitHub Actions job that runs the verifier against a small synthetic fixture set on every PR touching synthetic/ or runner/? prevents regressions earlier.
sasha: agreed — I'll add it to the eval CI matrix and include an explicit test case for renamed shard ids.
mike: also adding a metric to the dashboard: "holdout_overlap_rate" — alerts at >0.1% with a 1h window.
adele: great. leaving a note in the dataset docs about manifest naming and cache TTL. :thumbsup:
